item.title: Robin Kinross
item.description:
Editor, typographer, writer and critic. Founder of the publishing imprint Hyphen Press in 1980. Kinross has contributed much to magazines, including Eye, Blueprint, Information Design Journal, and the Journal of Design History.

Hyphen Press now publishes a range of titles on typography and design, recent Hyphen Press publications include the second edition of Modern Typography (2004), The Stroke (2005), and Gerrit Noordzij’s theory of writing.
